verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes an app-level lock (biometric or PIN) for 2FAS Auth that would prevent a borrowed phone from exposing codes; it only discusses cloud sync, backups, browser extension pairing, and Pass's 'Security Tiers' for a separate password-manager product, none of which document a PIN/biometric gate on the authenticator itself. Missing for 10: any first-party or independent evidence of biometric/PIN app-lock protecting 2FAS Auth codes.
